subject: Aligning mid-contract top-up with procurement windows
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Martin <ava.martin@helixtx.com>, Helix Therapeutics Procurement <procurement@helixtx.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aligning mid-contract top-up with procurement windows

Hi Ava / team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great context on the spike in inference usage tied to your new internal agent rollout. You mentioned you want to add capacity this quarter but also align billing to your existing contract renewal window (Nov 30). Two quick paths we can propose so legal/procurement can evaluate: 

1) Staged top-up (recommended for predictability)
   - Add 20% capacity immediately (token credits) with quarterly billing in arrears
   - 7% uplift discount on the incremental capacity for committing to two quarters
   - Amendment that co-terms with Nov 30 renewal (prorated credit applied on co-term)

2) One-time uplift with annualize/co-term
   - One payment for the expanded capacity, priced at 4% lower than monthly equivalent
   - Invoice issued now, contract amendment to annualize and co-term on Nov 30

I'm attaching a short quote and a draft amendment that shows the proration math. Key ask from procurement: what procurement window do we need to hit to guarantee current discount level (the finance team needs PO by Aug 31 for Q3 processing).

If helpful I can also break the price down into token buckets and expected monthly spend based on your recent telemetry. Please let me know whether procurement prefers Option 1 (staged, quarterly) or Option 2 (one-time with annualization), or if they need a third variant (e.g., a temporary surge bucket).

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0143

Attachment: HLX-TopUp-Quote-20260815.pdf
Attachment: proposed-amendment-HLX-042.docx

From: Ava Martin <ava.martin@helixtx.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Helix Therapeutics Procurement <procurement@helixtx.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning mid-contract top-up with procurement windows

Jordan — thanks for the summary and the draft. A few notes from procurement and finance: 

- Our renewal run date is Nov 30, that is fixed. We want the additional capacity to be effectively co-termed if possible so we don’t run two separate renewal flows.
- Finance needs a clear PO line (amount + account code) by Aug 31 to close in Q3. Can you provide a single-line PO amount for Option 1 and Option 2?
- Also need confirmation that data residency & audit logs for the extra capacity stay under the same compliance controls. (Legal will confirm but flagging here).

Can you also include the estimated monthly spend delta for the staged top-up option so we can run it through our budget tooling? If you can get that by EOD tomorrow, procurement will see if we can sign the amendment before Aug 31.

—Ava
Ava Martin
Senior Procurement Manager, Helix Therapeutics
ava.martin@helixtx.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-16T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Helix top-up — PO timing and co-term ask

Lauren / Ben — FYI, procurement asked for a single-line PO amount for Option 1 and Option 2, and we need to confirm compliance scoping stays identical. Quick pricing math below (draft numbers for legal review):

Option 1 — Staged top-up (20% capacity) - Incremental monthly token credits: 12M tokens - Unit price (incremental): $0.95 per 1k tokens (7% uplift discount vs standard incremental price) - Estimated incremental monthly spend: $11,400 - Quarterly billing (in arrears) so PO amount for Q3 (Sep+Oct+Nov proration to co-term): $33,800 (rounded)

Option 2 — One-time uplift, annualize on Nov 30 - One-time invoice today for the 20% bump, discounted by 4% vs monthly equivalent (pre-annualization): $130,000 - Amendment to annualize and co-term on Nov 30 with credit applied at co-term

Risks / asks: we need legal to confirm the proration line items and that the audit log/residency obligations are explicitly in the amendment. Also we should hold the 7% staged discount until Aug 31 (procurement PO deadline).

If both of you are good, I'll send a tightened PO-ready one-line for each option and a redline suggestion for the amendment. Do you want to keep the staged discount or make it conditional (PO in by Aug 31)?

Thanks,
Jordan

On internal tone: keep staged discount conditional on PO by Aug 31; if procurement misses the window, fall back to 3% uplift discount only.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Martin <ava.martin@helixtx.com>, Helix Therapeutics Procurement <procurement@helixtx.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning mid-contract top-up with procurement windows — PO-ready figures

Ava — attaching the PO-ready single-line numbers and a short breakdown for finance. I also added a compliance note in the amendment calling out that the added capacity inherits your existing data residency and audit log controls. 

PO-ready lines (pick one):

- Option 1 (Staged top-up, quarterly bill): PO amount for Q3 (Sep+Oct+Nov proration): $33,800 — description: "20% capacity staged top-up (Sep-Nov), quarterly billing; amendment to co-term 11/30/2026; staged discount 7% conditional on PO by 2026-08-31."

- Option 2 (One-time uplift, annualize): PO amount (one-time invoice): $130,000 — description: "One-time capacity uplift, amendment to annualize & co-term 11/30/2026; credit applied at co-term."

Next steps if either works: 1) Procurement confirms preferred PO line and account code; 2) I send DocuSign for the amendment (link below) and we route the invoice to your AP team after signature.

DocuSign link: https://redwood.app/docusign/HLX-042

If procurement wants the staged discount guaranteed beyond Aug 31, we can route an internal approval but that will need an exec-level signoff (Ben is CC'd).

Thanks — I can jump on a quick 15-min call tomorrow morning if you want to walk procurement through the numbers.

Best,
Jordan

Attachment: HLX-TopUp-Quote-20260815.pdf
Attachment: proposed-amendment-HLX-042.docx
